column2: {c4}Toru{c0}||A university student from the capital. 172 cm, 60 kg. He met Mari at school, but they aren't a couple yet.
{c4}Mari{c0}||Toru's classmate, same age. 165 cm, model figure, long straight hair. Athletic and sharp. Mr. Kobayashi's niece.
{c4}Jiro Kobayashi{c0}||Owner of the inn “Spur”. Quit his job years ago to run it. About 45, thin. He does most of the cooking.
{c4}Kyoko Kobayashi{c0}||The owner's wife. Warm and caring. Small, but a firm support for Mr. Kobayashi. Poor cook.
{c4}Toshio Kubota{c0}||Works at the inn and calls himself a sixth-year student. 184 cm, athletic, loves skiing. Sporty clothes.
{c4}Midori Shinozaki{c0}||Lives and works at the inn. In her twenties, round face, ponytail.
{c4}Keiko Kitano{c0}||One of the three office ladies. A bit plump but cute. Seems to prefer eating over skiing.
{c4}Kanako Watase{c0}||A thin, long-haired woman. Pretty, but a bit frivolous. Dresses flashily.
{c4}Aki Kawamura{c0}||One of the three office ladies, boyish. 18 like the others, but looks younger.
{c4}Seiichi Kayama{c0}||An Osaka company president who once looked after Mr. Kobayashi. Balding, heavyset.
{c4}Haruko Kayama{c0}||Kayama's wife. A tall, oval-faced beauty, elegant and quiet, unlike her husband.
{c4}Ichiro Tanaka{c0}||Age and job unknown. Wears a coat over a dark suit and sunglasses, out of place at a ski resort.
{c4}Yosuke Mikimoto{c0}||A freelance landscape photographer. 185 cm, sturdy and bearded: a true mountain man.
The story is set at a mountain inn.
You and your partner come here to ski.
Can you solve it and get out safely?
As the story goes on, “choices” will appear.
Choose well and you'll reach the culprit screen.
Enter the name of who you think the killer is.
If it ends badly, use the movement map to restart from any scene.
Press ф to open the map while reading.
Many stories (endings) await in this multi-scenario game.
What follows after naming the culprit? See for yourself.
Enjoy the world of “Kamaitachi no Yoru”.
